all.name: reach target single
all.instruction: Reach the target with the left wrist.

all.name: reach target multi modal
all.instruction: Reach the target with either wrist.

all.name: reach target dual
all.instruction: Reach the two targets, one with each wrist.

all.name: move plate
all.instruction: Move the plate between two draining racks.

all.name: move two plates
all.instruction: Move two plates simultaneously from one draining rack to the other.

all.name: flip cup
all.instruction: Flip the upside-down cup to an upright position.

all.name: flip cutlery
all.instruction: Take the cutlery from the holder, flip it, and place it back.

all.name: stack blocks
all.instruction: Move blocks across the table and stack them in the target area.

all.name: dishwasher close
all.instruction: Push back all trays and close the door of the dishwasher.

all.name: dishwasher load cups
all.instruction: Move the cups from the table into the dishwasher's upper tray.

all.name: dishwasher load cutlery
all.instruction: Move the cutlery from the holder on the table into the dishwasher's cutlery basket.

all.name: dishwasher load plates
all.instruction: Move the plates from the rack into the dishwasher's lower tray.

all.name: drawer top open
all.instruction: Open the top drawer of the kitchen cabinet.

all.name: drawer top close
all.instruction: Close the top drawer of the kitchen cabinet.

all.name: pick box
all.instruction: Pick up the box from the side table and place it on the counter.

all.name: put cups
all.instruction: Pick up the cups from the table and put them into the closed wall cabinet.

all.name: saucepan to hob
all.instruction: Take the saucepan from the closed cabinet and place it on the hob.

all.name: sandwich remove
all.instruction: Remove the sandwich from the frying pan.

all.name: wall cupboard open
all.instruction: Open the doors of the wall cabinet.

all.name: wall cupboard close
all.instruction: Close the doors of the wall cabinet.
